heading: Silent Inline Motor Undermount Rangehood 120cm 1600M3/Hr Black
productFeatures: Powerful silent extraction, Energy-efficient, Innovative design, Soft-touch controls and digital display, 5 speed levels, 15-minute auto shut-off timer, Flexible & functional, High-quality filters, Schweigen SteelFlex™ included
shortDesc: Perfect for cooking up a storm. The UM1170-12BS comes in stylish matte black to add sophistication and drama to modern kitchens. Designed for discreet mounting into 300mm deep cabinetry, it is ideal for kitchens where space is limited, or where the rangehood needs to be out of sight. Soft-touch controls operate the 5 speed settings and LED lighting, while dishwasher-safe mesh filters offer easy maintenance.
warranty: 10 Years Motor Warranty, 5 Years Canopy Warranty, Lifetime Filter Warranty, Lifetime GU10 LED Globe Warranty
webCopy: Help your large cooktop or island bench feel cohesive with this Schweigen 120cm Silent Undermount Rangehood. The powerful German‑designed inline Isodrive motor can manage frequent high‑heat stir‑fries and multi‑burner cooking when properly ducted and installed. Five fan speeds and a 15‑minute auto shut‑off timer match airflow to daily meals and hosting. The matte black finish disappears into overhead joinery, creating a concealed focal point that suits contemporary island benches and dark kitchen interiors.
